t: The reconstruction of Market Street from The Embarcadero to Sansome Street, by the Bureau of Street Repair and the Market Street Railways, is being done with the co-operation of this department.

Plans for traffic control of Market Street, from The Embarcadero to Van Ness Avenue, included location of vehicular and pedestrian signals, location of safety zones, cross-walks, and safety islands, laning work and arrows, and relocation of some curbs.
